context: Hiroshi farewells Ren at the end of his internship.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: レン君、インターン、お疲れ様。
lines.en: Ren. You've done good work as an intern.
lines.style: Quiet approval with weight behind it. Open with his name — direct, personal. Measured pace. No excess. The kind of praise that lands because it's rare and exact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Soft, earnest. Slight catch in the opening — moved but holding it back. Respectful pause before the 'really' — not performing gratitude, actually feeling it. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Your future — I'm looking forward to it.
lines.style: Firmer conviction this time. Not casual encouragement. He believes what he's saying. Slight lean forward on 'future.' Finality in the tone — this matters to him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 頑張ります、教えていただいた事。
lines.en: I'll work hard at everything you've taught me.
lines.style: Quiet commitment, almost to himself. No bravado. The sincerity of someone who means to keep the trust. Steady breath. Careful not to oversell.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Tell Kenji I'm grateful to him too.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact instruction, but warm underneath. Not demanding — asking Ren to carry something real. Eyes contact level. The weight of a small responsibility given with trust.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: もちろんです。一緒に、過ごせた事、大切。
lines.en: Of course. The time we spent together — it was precious.
lines.style: Slow, thoughtful. Not rushed. He's acknowledging what actually mattered in this. Soft trailing on 'precious' — not wringing emotion from the word, just letting it sit. Small, genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: いつでも、戻ってきていい。
lines.en: Come back anytime you need to.
lines.style: Final word. Not goodbye — opening a door. Steady, clear. The kind of permission that costs nothing and means everything. No 'maybe' in it.
